text:
===========================================================================
UniDPP demonstration run
scenario : battery-loop seed : 0x0000756e69647070 lib : unidpp-core 0.1.0
seed drives deterministic salt derivation only; production salts must come
from a CSPRNG. Every timestamp below is fixed, so identical seeds yield
byte-identical traces.
===========================================================================

SCENE Two cell passports (cell-a holding 12 kg, cell-b holding 13 kg) are
issued at lot/serial granularity; a pack-maker combines them into pack-1, a
harvester splits a module out, an installer mounts the pack into a car, a
theft is discovered on a cell, the loop closes at end-of-waste, and the
result is packed onto a Tier-A carrier and graded.

-- Step 1: Issuance of cell-a (finest recorded granularity) ----------------
  event:      Issuance by issuing authority / cell-maker, trust marker
               self-declared
  commitment: 862f53d1af4e07fe.. (unsalted; commits to the canonical body)
  state:      cell-a: 0 -> 1 sealed events; status issued; as-of state hash
               862f53d1af4e07fe..
  note:       A passport issues where legal duty attaches, and inputs are
               recorded at the finest identifier granularity available even
               when no passport regime yet exists behind them (dormant
               identifiers) (I7, I3).
-- Step 2: Issuance of cell-b (finest recorded granularity) ----------------
  event:      Issuance by issuing authority / cell-maker, trust marker
               self-declared
  commitment: 10f0bb704b40feec.. (unsalted; commits to the canonical body)
  state:      cell-b: 0 -> 1 sealed events; status issued; as-of state hash
               10f0bb704b40feec..
  note:       A passport issues where legal duty attaches, and inputs are
               recorded at the finest identifier granularity available even
               when no passport regime yet exists behind them (dormant
               identifiers) (I7, I3).
-- Step 3: Combine (N -> 1): cells -> pack-1 -------------------------------
  spec:       pack-1 <- [cell-a 12000 g @ state 862f53d1af4e07fe.., cell-b
               13 kg @ state 10f0bb704b40feec..], available [cell-a 12 kg,
               cell-b 13 kg], stamp context notified-body.example 12 kg
  state:      mass balance 25 kg in, 24.2 kg out, loss 0.8 kg (in - out =
               loss, auditable)
  event:      Issuance (derived, carrying inputReferences) then Combine,
               both by pack-maker, trust marker attested
  commitment: issuance a6d2e24396b38139.., combine fd5b6c21bfb30827..
               (unsalted; H(prev || canonical body))
  state:      pack-1: 0 -> 2 sealed events; status issued; chain verify: OK
  note:       The output passport's issuance event carries inputReferences
               [(passport, quantity, as-of state hash)], so pack-1
               hash-links its sources in a Git-merge topology; output
               quantities are new measured facts computed by the
               transformation, never copies, and the inputs transition to
               consumed while remaining verifiable for as-of queries (I4,
               I8).
-- Step 4: Split (1 -> N): harvest module mod-1 from pack-1 ----------------
  event:      Split by harvester (custodian), trust marker attested
  commitment: b547e941daa2cf69..
  state:      carve-out mod-1 10 kg; remainder 14.2 kg stays with pack-1;
               parent consumed: false
  note:       Sum of children is bounded by the parent (remainder
               semantics): mod-1 departs as a new passport with derivedFrom
               + carve-out, while pack-1 retains the remainder and its full
               history (I4).
-- Step 5: Blind installation: pack-1 -> car-eu-42 (consumer edge) ---------
  event:      Install (blind edge) by repairer-9, trust marker attested
  commitment: 7bcd4f5cc4da3d6c.. (salted; H(salt || prev || body)); the
               parent appears only as H(salt || car-eu-42)
  state:      pack-1: 3 -> 4 sealed events; salt dropped after use, only
               salt_ref 3 recorded; serialized log leaks car id: NO, salt:
               NO; chain verify OK: true, verify_with_salts OK: true
  binding proof: verify_parent_binding(car-eu-42, salt) -> true;
               verify_parent_binding(car-eu-99, salt) -> false
  note:       Proof-of-binding is not knowledge-of-parent: the child
               satisfies the parent-knowledge requirement cryptographically,
               so the installation is verifiable as validly mounted in some
               parent without revealing the household that holds the car;
               the log anchors commitments, never facts (I12).
-- Step 6: Theft discovered on cell-a: taint propagation through the DAG ---
  event:      FlagSecurity (theft, police-report-77) on cell-a, trust
               marker attested
  commitment: 27aa13de217ab424..
  state:      taint {fraud, source cell-a, window from 2023-07-14}
               propagates: pack-1 voids ab initio: true, mod-1 voids ab
               initio: true, cell-b voids ab initio: false; recall set of
               cell-a = [cell-a, mod-1, pack-1]
  note:       Revocation reason determines retroactivity: theft and fraud
               void validity ab initio over an explicit window, so the
               derived pack and the harvested module cannot be laundered
               through transformation, while the untainted cell-b branch
               stays clean; marking a passport fraudulent is a graph event,
               not merely a trust-list event (I9).
-- Step 7: End-of-waste: pack-1 re-enters commerce as secondary material ---
  event:      EndOfWaste (evidence eow-cert-9) by recycler, trust marker
               attested
  commitment: e960afac42dd5aa6..
  state:      pack-1 status issued -> end-of-waste (legal transition;
               replayed from the log)
  note:       Status changes are normative state-machine transitions with
               dated applicability; the passport is never rewritten, only
               appended to (I6, I4).
-- Step 8: Tier-A packing: the offline minimum vs the QR budget ------------
  fields:     product id 01+4006381333931+21+PACK1, resolver
               https://dpp.unidpp.org/r/pack-1, passport
               urn:unidpp:passport:pack-1, eo eo-de-042, status
               end-of-waste, safety none, as-of 2023-11-20T17:06:40Z, log
               head e960afac42dd5aa6..
  budget:     product_id 25B, resolver_uri 31B, passport_id 26B, eo_id 9B,
               status 12B, safety 4B, validity 40B, as_of 20B, log_head 64B,
               sig_slot 75B, sig_slot 73B; encoded 277 B, projected 405 B
               (signature placeholders counted at canonical suite lengths)
               into QR v15 EC m capacity 412 B: margin +7 B
  round trip: decode reproduces product id 01+4006381333931+21+PACK1 and 2
               signature slots (framed only)
  budget wall: replacing the suites with ML-DSA-65 (a 3309 B signature) is
               rejected, never silently truncated: Tier-A payload projects
               to 3570 bytes but the QR carrier holds at most 2331 bytes (EC
               m, version <= 40): shrink the resolver URI or drop signature
               suites
  note:       Tier A is the carrier-embedded minimum viable passport,
               budgeted against the ISO/IEC 18004 byte-capacity tables;
               over-budget payloads fail loudly instead of quietly shrinking
               the offline minimum (I13).
-- Step 9: Profile applicability: predicate trigger on twin facts ----------
  state:      profile urn:unidpp:profile:eu-battery-v3 on axes EU x
               batteries x - triggers where battery.capacity-kwh >= 2; twin
               fact battery.capacity-kwh = 2.5 -> applies: true
  note:       Profiles attach by predicate over twin facts on the
               jurisdiction x sector axes; the lens selects and transforms
               but never redefines the canonical facts (I10, I2).
-- Step 10: Graded verdicts: fresh, stale, offline, tampered ---------------
  verdict 1:  reading current-state; freshness fresh; coverage 2/2; trust
               log-anchored; outcome DEGRADED (signatures-framed-only)
    current state: VOIDS AB INITIO: retroactive taint present (fraud laundering
               prevented)
  verdict 2:  reading evidentiary; freshness stale; coverage 2/2; trust
               log-anchored; outcome DEGRADED (stale-data as-of
               2023-11-20T17:06:40Z)
  verdict 3:  reading evidentiary; freshness fresh; coverage 0/0; trust
               unsigned; outcome DEGRADED (offline-no-anchor)
  verdict 4:  reading cryptographic; freshness fresh; coverage 0/0; trust
               unsigned; outcome FAIL (broken-chain)
  tampering:  one character of the end-of-waste evidence reference was
               edited in the serialized log; the unsalted commitment no
               longer recomputes
  note:       Verification is graded, never boolean: framing-only
               signatures degrade explicitly with a stated reason, offline
               verification without a cached anchor degrades rather than
               fails, bounded freshness goes stale on the ladder, and any
               in-place mutation of history fails outright against the hash
               chain (I9, I13, I4).

===========================================================================
End of scenario. Exit status 0.
